notes.title: Development Update: Bespoke now has a Discord!
notes.content:
[p][b]Bespoke now has a Discord![/b]
[/p][p]If you're curious about Bespoke, or simply wish to chat with arcade racing enthusiasts, feel free to join the Discord and go behind the scenes to see the course of Bespoke's development, future plans, WIP dev footage, and more. [/p][p][/p][p]This Steam page will continue to be maintained and updated with news and important announcements, but expect much more frequent updates, and development-centered posts in the Discord server.[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/HWKMhKSuzs"]https://discord.gg/HWKMhKSuzs[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Looking forward to seeing you in the Discord![/p][p][/p][p]/ocelot[/p][p] [/p]
